key_insight: FeePredict uses historical Medicare fee-schedule data to predict whether reimbursement rates will change, which direction they will move, and by how much.
clinical_relevance: By anticipating payment changes, healthcare organizations may better plan operations, budgeting, and service strategy around Medicare reimbursement updates.
method: Uses lag-1 feature engineering and train-only preprocessing to avoid leakage.
Evaluated with chronological out-of-time validation across CMS fee schedules.
evidence_signal: Across the four Medicare fee schedules, the model achieved concordance indices of 0.815 to 0.998 and reduced mean absolute error by 29% to 85%, with permutation testing showing no evidence of leakage (AUC 0.467-0.515).
watch_item: Generalizability was weaker outside the training period for the Physician Fee Schedule, so performance may drop when Medicare policy regimes shift.
paper_title: A Multi-Schedule Machine Learning Pipeline for Medicare Reimbursement Change Prediction and Operational Risk Stratification
